audit_title: Theme / Motif Identity Evidence Readiness Audit for PF-001 Physical Classical Corpus
governing_principle: Do not promote synthetic segment identity into thematic identity. Theme/motif identity requires accepted, lineage-valid evidence across admissible routes. Human participation remains optional unless a subjective-human claim is made.

ROUTE_A.name: Independently adjudicated musicological/theme annotations
ROUTE_A.description: Dual-blind musicological annotation of motif boundaries and variants with inter-annotator agreement Cohen's kappa >= 0.80.

ROUTE_B.name: Lineage-valid explicit recurrence-family metadata with reproducible identity evidence
ROUTE_B.description: Formal catalog or score metadata documenting explicit recurrence families (e.g. variation themes, fugal subjects) with reproducible machine-checkable identity evidence.

lineage_policy_verdict.rationale: Neither Route A (independently adjudicated annotations) nor Route B (lineage-valid explicit recurrence-family metadata) currently provides sufficient physical score coverage across the 62 verified physical scores. Therefore, THEME_MOTIF_IDENTITY and THEMATIC_MEMORY_GATE remain non-operational. PF-002A operational scope is strictly restricted to SOURCE_SEGMENT_IDENTITY_ONLY and SOURCE_SEGMENT_STRUCTURAL_MEMORY.
